verdict.rationale: Replit docs explicitly support inviting teammates to a project where each person can start Agent threads while working together (replit-docs-14), directly matching the shared workspace story. However, evidence is limited to a single doc snippet with no detail on real-time concurrent editing, permissions, or team-plan specifics, and community feedback raises concerns about tooling conflicts (e.g., git operation clashes) that could undermine multi-user collaboration reliability.
